A.execution: monolithic full-causal, restart positions, generate_ids, fixed work

BP.execution: trained fresh: independent canonical encode per pass, k=5 link layout, generate_independent_ids

CP.execution: trained cached: DocCache entries via CanonicalCache, write-through misses, k=5 link layout

DP.execution: trained full-causal no-link monolithic prefill; TTFT only, D1 block only, diagnostic

d_resolutions.D1: untimed per-unit prebuild into unit store; reset to hit pre-state; verify after every block
d_resolutions.D2: mixed-hit misses encode on trained model via CanonicalCache write-through inside timed pass; pruned untimed after every pass; miss counts recorded; all-hit cells fail closed
d_resolutions.D3: BP runs in every block of every cell
d_resolutions.D4: 3 warmups + 15 timed repeats; cap shrink to 10 allowed; 10 is the floor

gates.primary: A/CP paired ratio of medians, 10k resamples, seed 47, CI 0.95; win CI_low>1.05, lose CI_high<1/1.05, else tie
gates.identity: CP vs BP generated ids byte-identical per repeat, every block; divergence pauses (abort) unless --continue-on-identity-divergence
descriptive: DP TTFT ratio vs A TTFT
